label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
Here's it. Fair, specific, and useful for anyone else moving — nothing in there he needs to be embarrassed about.

**Title:** Great value and great lads, but wrap the lamps!

**Review:**

Moved on Sat 17 Oct from Phibsborough up to Drumcondra — 2 bed flat, 4th floor walk up, no lift, and it was mostly my own stuff rather than a mountain of furniture. Booked through the website, €50 deposit by Revolut. Quote was €340 for up to 4 hours with two lads and the van. Best value I found by a mile; the other quotes I had were €450 and up.

They did run late. They texted at 8:40 to say the previous job had overrun and they were meant to be there at 9, but they turned up at half 10 and I was sat on the boxes with a coffee gone cold. I'll say this bit straight away because if you're moving on the same day as a landlord handover or a key collection, that extra half hour is a bigger deal than it was for me. For me it wasn't the end of the world, just sitting there waiting, so I didn't want to make a drama of it. The job itself took about three and a half hours, well inside the four hours quoted, so the delay was their time and not my money.

Credit to Dessie as well — he knocked €40 off the price after, unprompted, before I even mentioned it. That's decent of him and it's a good bit of business. It's a big part of why I'm giving four stars instead of three.

The actual moving was excellent. Big one for me was the couch wouldn't go round the turn on the 3rd floor. One of the young lads (Kev, I think) took the legs off it with an allen key he happened to have in his pocket and it went straight in. That saves you half an hour and a good bit of swearing. They also put the bed back together at the end without being asked and took away the flatpack shelf I didn't want, no charge for either.

The one thing I did lose was the base of my brass floor lamp — chipped in the move. They wrapped everything else in blankets and did a proper job with it, but the lamp base took a knock and it's my nan's, so I'm a bit gutted about it. Four stars is because of the lamp and the lateness, but I don't think it was carelessness, more that nobody thinks a lamp needs wrapping. Lads, wrap the lamps. That's the note, that's the only note.

If you're moving anywhere in Dublin, genuinely, I'd use them again. Two lads, their own van, the price quoted was the price paid less the €40, and the crew clearly knew what they were doing on a walk-up with no lift. Compared to what else was on the table, miles better value.

And Dessie, if you're reading this — a bit more notice on the text when you're running behind would go a long way. But the discount without being asked goes a long way too. Cheers for that.

---

A few things I did deliberately: named him warmly rather than keeping it vague (people find "the man with the van" reviews useless), gave the lateness a real paragraph so it isn't a throwaway insult, and put the €40 back in so the review reads fair rather than grudging. Posted as 4 stars.

Want a shorter version too? If it's for Google, some people skim, and I can cut it to around 200 words with the same points if that's easier.
